method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (employment for a partnership and an administration under a s 49 declaration answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Fair Entitlements Guarantee Act 2012, Compilation No. 5, compilation date 21 February 2025 (register id C2025C00164, retrieved 2026-09-22), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2012A00159.txt. No instrument brought in: the indexed maximum weekly wage (Fair Entitlements Guarantee Regulations 2012, not deposited) and the PAYG withholding amount are inputs.

scope: From the seat of the former employee: s 5 (insolvency event, wages entitlement period, maximum weekly wage as an input), s 6, s 7 (wages), s 10(1) (eligibility, conditional on the Secretary's satisfaction), s 11(1)-(2), s 12(1), s 13 (exclusions), s 14(1)-(5) (claim deadline and effectiveness), s 16(1)-(4), ss 17, 18 (the Secretary's reductions as inputs), s 19, ss 20-24, 26, 27 (amounts and the maximum weekly wage caps), s 34 (repaying after a later payment), s 38(1)-(2), s 40(1), s 41 (review). Out: partnerships (ss 10(2), 11(3), 12(2), 25(3), 33) and s 49 administrations (not covered); s 25 and costs of the winding up (stated by the person); s 28; ss 29-33; s 35; s 37; s 38(3)-(6); s 39; s 40(3); Part 6 Division 3; ss 47, 48, 50-55.
seat: the former employee of an insolvent or bankrupt employer, claiming a Fair Entitlements Guarantee advance
